LD 1173- Resolve, to Establish a Group to Study the Laws Governing the Guardianship of Adults and Ongoing Parental Rights of Parents of Disabled Adults
Dear Senator Carney, Representative Kuhn and Honorable Members of the Judiciary Committee,
My name is Catherine Moore, and I am the Register of Probate for Lincoln County and President of the Maine Association Registers of Probate (MARP), and I am speaking on behalf ofMARP.
If a group is established to study the Laws Governing the Guardianship of Adults and Ongoing Parental Rights of Parents ofDisabled Adults, we ask that 2 members of Maine Association Registers of Probate be part of the Study Group.

10041045:
March 31, 2025
100 State House Station Augusta, ME 04333
Testimony in Support of LD 1173 Resolve, to Establish a Group to Study the Laws Governing the Guardianship of Adults and Ongoing Parental Rights of Parents of Disabled Adults
Senator Carney, Representative Kuhn, and members of the Judiciary Committee,
My name is Cindy Thielen, and I live in Bangor. I am a self-advocate, meaning I am a person who lives with a disability. I am also a member of Speaking Up For Us, Maine's Self-Advocacy Network.
I am in support of LD# 1173 because it is important to look at how guardianship affects self-advocates. I was under guardianship for years and I didn't always feel like what I wanted was considered or how guardianship affected me.
I think it would also be important for you to include a self-advocate and a parent in the membership group. Parents and self-advocates are at the center of this and should be included in this.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
Sincerely,
Cindy Thielen Bangor, ME thielencindy@gmail.com
